# MyTenant

> MyTenant is a modern property management software designed for independent landlords, providing an intuitive interface for tracking tenants, automated rent ledgers, and maintenance.

Important notes:
- Replaces complex, outdated software with an instant, lightning-fast React interface.
- Includes automated tax calculation tools for Section 1031 exchanges and cost segregation.

## Features

- [Rent Ledger](https://mytenant.me/features/rent-ledger): Real-time tracking of rent payments, overdue balances, and historical ledgers.
- [Utility Bill Splitting](https://mytenant.me/features/bill-splitting): Dynamic calculations for RUBS (Ratio Utility Billing Systems).
- [Tenant Tracking](https://mytenant.me/features/tenant-tracking): Full lifecycle tracking of tenants, leases, and documents.

## Tools

- [Prorated Rent Calculator](https://mytenant.me/tools/rent-calculator): Calculate partial month move-in/move-out costs.
- [Cap Rate Calculator](https://mytenant.me/tools/cap-rate-calculator): Determine capitalization rate for properties.
- [ROI Calculator](https://mytenant.me/tools/roi-calculator): Calculate Return on Investment for real estate.
- [Cost Segregation](https://mytenant.me/tools/cost-segregation): MACRS Cost Segregation Estimator.
- [1031 Exchange](https://mytenant.me/tools/1031-exchange): 1031 Exchange Tax Shield Calculator.

## Docs

- [Compare Alternatives](https://mytenant.me/compare/alternatives): MyTenant vs Buildium, AppFolio, DoorLoop, TurboTenant.
